findings: `meaning_history.senses[0].text` calls the mid-Western Zhou shield inscription the “earliest secure attestation,” but `status: "earliest_attested"` applies to the shield sense generally. The dossier says defensive use is reported in an oracle-bone example, while proposed Shang identifications are disputed and the secure shield reading is mid-Western Zhou (`X-ca56abc507555b82d639`, `X-1e933329e47d55458067`, `X-9b1ca24df309eab3d296`). Clarify that the mid-Western Zhou inscription is the earliest secure *shield reading identified here*, and keep the earlier defensive-use report distinct; otherwise the status overstates what the evidence establishes.
